records.question: Who pays if I wreck the inside of a Lyft driver's car?
records.text: If a Driver reports that you have materially damaged their vehicle, you agree to pay a "Damage Fee" of up to $250, depending on the extent of the damage, towards vehicle repair or cleaning [Lyft – Charges].

records.question: What ID might Lyft ask me to upload to prove who I am?
records.text: Lyft may ask for documents related to identification, such as a driver's license, a profile picture, or "selfie" imagery [Lyft – A. Information You Provide to Us]. If you apply to be a Driver, Lyft will collect information like government identification number (such as social security number) and driver's license information [Lyft – A. Information You Provide to Us].

records.question: Am I able to quit Discord whenever I like?
records.text: Yes, you are free to stop using Discord's services at any time and for any reason [Discord – Term & Termination]. To end the agreement, you can delete your Discord account through the Settings page in the Discord app [Discord – Term & Termination].

records.question: Could my information be handed over if Discord gets bought by another company?
records.text: Yes, Discord may disclose information if it is evaluating or engaging in a merger, acquisition, reorganization, bankruptcy, or sale, transfer, or change in ownership of Discord or any of its assets [Discord – How we disclose your information].

records.question: What can I do if somebody posts my copyrighted work on Reddit?
records.text:
If you believe something on Reddit infringes a copyright or a trademark that you own or control, you can notify Reddit's Designated Agent by using the [Copyright Report Form](https://support.reddithelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=16510899084308&tf_16510589022228=contact_form_copyright_infringement_dmca) or the [Trademark Report Form](https://support.reddithelp.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=16510899084308&tf_16510589022228=contact_form_trademark_request), or by contacting the Copyright Agent at Reddit, Inc. [Reddit – 9. Copyright, Trademark, the DMCA, and Takedowns].

You can also contact the Copyright Agent at:
Reddit, Inc.
303 2nd Street, Suite 500S
San Francisco, CA 94107
copyright@reddit.com [Reddit – 9. Copyright, Trademark, the DMCA, and Takedowns]

records.question: Does Reddit know exactly where I am?
records.text: Reddit does not track your precise location [Reddit – Introduction]. However, they automatically collect information about your approximate location based on their Logs Data [Reddit – What Information We Collect]. Location information may also be received from you if you choose to share it through the Location Customization setting or by associating your content with a location [Reddit – What Information We Collect].

records.question: If I drop my Zoom plan early, do I get money back for the rest of the term?
records.text: If you have a right of withdrawal or a cooling-off period under applicable Law, you may request to terminate the affected Services according to applicable Law and, if applicable, receive a pro rata refund of any prepaid and unused Charges [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES]. However, all payments are final and non-refundable unless Zoom agrees otherwise, it is required by Law, or it is stated in your Order Form [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES].

records.question: Can a 14 year old create a Zoom account?
records.text: Zoom does not allow children under the age of 16 to sign up for a Zoom account [Zoom – Children]. Additionally, Zoom is not intended for use by individuals under the age of sixteen (16) years old, unless it is through a School Subscriber using Zoom for Education (K-12) [Zoom – 11. records.question: What happens to the money left in my PayPal balance when my account is shut?
records.text: After your account is closed, PayPal may retain your electronic money for a period and to the extent reasonably required to protect PayPal and/or any third party against risks such as reversals, fees, fines, penalties, and other liabilities [Paypal – Closing Your PayPal Account]. After this time, you will be able to withdraw any undisputed funds that PayPal is holding [Paypal – Closing Your PayPal Account].

records.question: Can Strava work out things about my health from my workouts?

records.question: Can a 15 year old use Pinterest?

records.question: How do I erase everything Pinterest has on me?
records.text: You can have your information deleted by selecting “Delete your data and account” in your settings and following the instructions [Pinterest – Your Rights and Choices].
